instruction: Analyze the customer review and summarize the customer's satisfaction, main positive product attribute, and main concern.
context:
I'm surprised other reviewers loved this one so much. it's completely different then how it looks on the model. it's much shorter, which others do mention, but it flares a lot. enough to feel maternity-ish on me. it looks fitted on the model. maybe it's my shape, i have a short torso and carry weight in my hips. i ordered an xs too. i will say the material
is very nice and it's well made, but it's going back.
target:
Satisfaction: mixed
Main positive: The material is very nice
Main concern: It's going back
